comment: Which of a zone's layer filters (its LVB's layer sets, by ID) the client is told to show (ZoneInit's and ActorSetPos' transition_territory_filter_key), by quest progress. Retail's server picks it; the client's layout shows a layer only if its filter list has (or, for some, hasn't) that key, and with 0 in a zone like these every stage of the story stands there at once (Bob's Waking Sands screenshot, 2026-10-26). For each territory, the last entry whose quest has been accepted (and got as far as its sequence, if it has one) or completed applies (an entry without one is the default). Recorded: Bob's Chronofoil capture afe32479 visit 0.10 (2026-10-25), the Waking Sands during The Scions of the Seventh Dawn (509): 90338 in ZoneInit at its last step and in the ActorSetPos after it was completed; 90339 in the ActorSetPos as A Wild Rose by Any Other Name (510) was accepted, and after. Bob's Chronofoil capture b8432613 (2026-10-27): 90339 through Lord of the Inferno (343); 90340 in the ActorSetPos as A Hero in the Making (511) was accepted, and in ZoneInit to its end and The Company You Keep (Twin Adder, 680) being accepted; 90341 in ZoneInit once Wood's Will Be Done (683, the Twin Adders' next step; 684 and 685 are the other two companies': 685 the same in Bob's Chronofoil capture c99fe374 of 2026-10-28, 684 taken to be) was accepted; 90342 in the ActorSetPos as Sylph-management (513, which follows any of the three) was accepted. Back from the Wood (746): 90342 in ZoneInit with it at sequence 2, then 90343 in the ActorSetPos (warp type 18, after PrepareZoning to the same territory) as its Waking Sands cutscene moved it to 255, and 90343 at every later visit (Bob's Chronofoil captures 9df4ff01 and 3a705e18, 2026-10-30); an entry's "sequence" is how far its quest must have got. Wrath of the Titan (516): 90343 in ZoneInit before it, then 90344 in the ActorSetPos (warp type 18, where the player stood) as its accepting cutscene ended (Bob's Chronofoil capture 44df02fc, 2026-11-03). 92218 in ZoneInit with 517 at sequence 2 and in the ActorSetPos as it moved to 3 (Bob's Chronofoil captures 650dbfd8, 0fd8bce0 and 48aaf6fe, 2026-11-05: every visit there; its layer QST_ManFst313, 517's, has it); taken from 517's acceptance. 92219 in ZoneInit and in-zone ActorSetPos with Bringing out the Dead (876) at sequence 2 (Bob's Chronofoil capture 130088ec, 2026-11-06: the only visit after 517); the layer that carries it is QST_ManFst405's, a quest neither capture had, so what moves it on (876, or something between 517's end and 876) is a guess: taken from 876's acceptance. When the key changes within a visit, the server warps the player where they stand, as retail did (`ZoneConnection::refresh_layer_filter`). Reclamation (520, ManFst405, whose layer carries 92219): 92219 in ZoneInit with it at sequence 255, then 92220 in the ActorSetPos (warp type 1, arg 2) as it was completed and its last cutscene put the player in the Solar, and in ZoneInit at the next visit (Bob's Chronofoil captures 6a5244ec, 6c495fc4 and 09ecf8e7 of 2026-11-08, 689b15da of 2026-11-09); an entry's "completed" asks for its quest's completion, not its acceptance. Casing the Castrum's Y'shtola (4309241) stands under 92220.
